requirements.title: SIZE argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be assumed-rank or an array, shall not be an unallocated allocatable variable or a disassociated pointer, assumed-size ARRAY requires DIM present with value less than rank, DIM shall be an integer scalar in range, and KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.SIZE-ARRAY-assumed-rank-or-array: Positive controls call SIZE with ordinary arrays and assumed-rank dummies; source-control mutations use scalar nonarray actuals and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.SIZE-ARRAY-allocated-or-associated: Positive controls use allocated allocatables and associated pointers before calling SIZE; source-control mutations use unallocated allocatables and disassociated pointers and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.SIZE-assumed-size-requires-valid-DIM: Positive controls call SIZE for assumed-size dummies with DIM less than rank; source-control mutations omit DIM or use the final assumed-size dimension and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.SIZE-DIM-integer-scalar-in-range: Positive controls use DIM values one through rank; source-control mutations use zero, rank plus one, and noninteger DIM actuals and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.SIZE-KIND-scalar-integer-constant: Positive controls use absent KIND and a selected integer kind constant; source-control mutations use nonconstant or nonscalar KIND expressions and claim no diagnostic facet.
